question.worked_solution:
First, we convert the given probability into a cumulative probability:

$$
\begin{aligned}P(X<-1)=0.3783\,⇒\,P(X\le -1)=0.3783\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we transform to a standard normal random variable by $z$-scoring:

$$
\begin{aligned}P(X\le -1) & =0.3783 \\ P(Z\le \frac{-1-2}{\sigma }) & =0.3783 \\ Φ(-\frac{3}{\sigma }) & =0.3783 \\ -\frac{3}{\sigma } & ={Φ}^{-1}(0.3783)\end{aligned}
$$

According to the table, we have

$$
Φ(-0.31)=0.3783\,⇒\,{Φ}^{-1}(0.3783)=-0.31.
$$

Therefore, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}-\frac{3}{\sigma } & =-0.31 \\ \sigma  & ≈9.68\end{aligned}
$$

to $2$ decimal places.
